title: too many combobox not long dropdown
rule: Too many (~15+) → combobox, not a long dropdown.

citation.source: NN/g — Does Your Form Really Need a Dropdown List?

pass_when: A ~15+ set is a combobox (type + list), not a long dropdown.
fail_when: A long dropdown of ~15+ with no type-to-find.
overview: Sets of ~15+ options need a combobox, not a long dropdown alone.
apply_when: Large option sets of roughly fifteen or more choices.
not_when: Long ~15+ dropdowns with no type-to-find combobox pattern.
agent_hint: For ~15+ options use a combobox with type-plus-list, not a long dropdown.
description: Too many options (about fifteen or more) need a combobox with type plus list, not a long dropdown alone. Users should be able to type to find within the set rather than scroll a lengthy closed list. Pass when a roughly fifteen-plus option set is a combobox rather than a long dropdown. Fail when a long dropdown of about fifteen-plus options offers no type-to-find.
do_not_claim: Apple combo-box pairing (`forms.inputs.combo_box`) as a duplicate; a house “15” as law.
